dedupe_keys.name: mexico siap agricultural production statistics open data municipal 1980 2025

description: Mexico's annual crop production statistics as open data. The SIAP page says users can download yearly basic agricultural statistics at national, state, rural development district and municipal level, with the 2025 closing figures at municipal level as a 5.9 MB CSV, municipal files for 2003 to 2025 updated on 12 August 2026, national series for 1980 to 2002, and a data dictionary and metadata in XLSX. The files are free downloads. Coverage is Mexico, by municipality. Caveats: the licence is not stated on the page read, and older years are only national. For simulation it gives planted, harvested and lost areas and production by municipality, to relate crop losses to droughts, hurricanes and floods. A related catalogue record is the MIRCA irrigated planted fractions for the US-Mexico border.
